Question ID: ANP_U03_L07_GP_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.ANP.SKM.03

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Myoneural Junctions and Movement Control
Stimulus: Neuromuscular signal model

A student is reviewing the required visual and must explain the first visible structure-function connection. Which answer uses the lesson evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, start with motor neuron signal arrival. Then use the required stimulus (Neuromuscular signal model) to connect the visible evidence to myoneural junctions and movement control. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.ANP.SKM.03 and avoids the common mistake: thinking the nerve directly pulls the muscle.
